what: The boundary between two sheets is drawn as a wave sloping down to the lower right — below the boundary, the sum of four sines (frequencies 1.47, 1.20, 1.55, 2.18) is the accent color, a light accent band dances along the boundary, and above it is the background color. It draws only while visible, once every 2~3 frames (3 in the last 10%) (WebGL shader)

options.slope: Tilt multiplier (horizontal tilt 1.8 × this value), default 1
options.--fx-wave-fill·band·bg: Colors for the bottom fill, band and top background (CSS variables), default --kf-accent · --kf-accent-soft · --kf-bg

from.where: shared.js wave() · index.html .mk-wave (green hill boundary below the hero — original Wave canvas)
